decision.title: Core language
decision.summary: sxml is written in portable C17 with C23 features behind macros, chosen for linking reach, with memory-safety risk mitigated by sanitizers, fuzzing and checked arithmetic.

body.p: Portable C17 with C23 features behind macros, following docs/C_GUIDELINES.md. Chosen for the widest linking reach (every platform and language can call C). Memory-safety risk is mitigated by sanitizers, fuzzing and checked arithmetic.
